This is a continuous state that is not related to the source frame that is reported in the same data item, and may also be reported in a data item where the FrameIDA- vailable and PayloadAvailable fields are set to 0 . The Error-Passive state shall be set to 1 when the CAN controller is in the Error-Passive state, and to 0 when it is in the Error-Active or Bus-Off state.
